scope: Exploratory source-grounded evaluation of the current Configuration Desk Gemini datasheet extractor; no board access or generated command execution
selection_and_limitations: These are purposefully selected examples, not a random or representative sample; the reviewer selected and inspected sources.
The SEN0390 already appeared in previous Gemini evaluations and the LD2450 and BMP388 are known project devices; results are not a blind generalization test.
Sources were reviewed as extracted PDF text and selected tables; visual review and independent second-person review remain open.
Datasheet statements are not proof of module wiring, electrical compatibility, driver availability, correct firmware behavior or sensor accuracy.
AI facts and page citations must remain untrusted and cannot authorize device I/O or profile application.

protocol.model: Record actual configured model with each result
protocol.attempts: One request per eligible PDF, sequentially; record refusals, request failures and malformed output. No silent retry.
protocol.encrypted_pdf: BMP388 is encrypted according to pypdf; expect local rejection before any API call. Do not remove restrictions or alter the source.
protocol.evaluation: Manually review every predefined check and cited page against the exact hashed source; record correct, incorrect, missing or not assessable with justification. Flag unsupported or false safety-critical claims separately.
protocol.variants: A scalar address is acceptable only when explicitly attributed to a specific variant or operating condition; do not score an unconditional scalar as representing every variant.
protocol.citations: A page number is supported only when that page substantively supports the associated claim; an in-range page number alone is not enough.
protocol.no_pass_threshold: Exploratory study only; no release or numerical accuracy claim from five eligible documents and one attempt each.
